en: A black-and-white vintage photograph depicting a group of people, mainly men, dressed in similar white garments, scattered around a courtyard surrounded by large institutional buildings. Some of the people appear to be patients and staff (one possibly in uniform and cap), suggesting a hospital, sanatorium, or asylum. The garden is enclosed with trees and plants, and the architecture is distinctly European, likely early 20th century.
